Current backup governance, namespace/readiness/source proof and transfer fence retained.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.revision: Exact normalized ID and payloadHash; independent stable principal on initial approval. Immutable journal links require actual posted nonreversed entry/date/currency/exact side amount and retained current heads. Later ledger writes stale links; no refresh/waiver. Status balanced iff posted without exceptions, never settled. No period reopening, posting, payment or consolidation effects.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.confirmation: Plan no confirmation; all six lifecycle writes inner confirm:true and CLI/MCP outer true. HTTP32KiB unique-key JSON recursively rejects duplicates; plan positional outer tuple allowed, write outer tuple blocked by confirm lookup. No extra fresh-MFA requirement beyond Current session.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.atomicity: Held Owner/control IMMEDIATE writer plus protected admitted two-company observations. Source physical originals and canonical journal chains checked; company snapshot read transactions rolled back, only control lifecycle commits. Selection restoration occurs BEFORE commit; restore failure rolls back and retires if nonreusable, server503 internal. Commit failure OutcomeUnknown retires. Plan/status rollback business transaction; broader admission/metadata absence is not inferred noneffect.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.globalPreprocessing: HTTP protocol-major/wire-profile/manifest negotiation precedes leaf. Host/current origin proof then cookie; corporate HEAD alone early405 before proof/body/Owner. MCP Session framing/init/id/params then tools::call object guard and report-selector string guard before native leaf; no public tuple-array arguments. CLI main original_args preflight then global local_binding consumes split/attached --local-profile before remote parse; explicit private matching Unix/exact logical origin, no server spawn/discovery/TCP fallback. Generic source/report/service/audit/backup/archive/budget guards precede selected leaf. No --json or human-output alias on these remote commands.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.sdkValidation: Native body preflight uses actual domain::validate, not a full JSON Schema evaluator: ignores oneOf, uniqueItems, pattern and min/maxLength on null. Integer checks as_i64; string lengths UTF8 bytes. Ownership/corporate utf8_bounds expands schema maxLength4x; server still enforces trimmed UTF16 source bounds. SDK accepts dispositionId:null in plan/propose schema but native default String rejects explicit null (omission/empty generates). No adapter rewrites input bytes.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.transportStages: Every send first fetches passive protocol manifest without credentials on same transport; no redirects/proxy inheritance/retry, connect10s/total30s. Generic ownership/corporate discard all non2xx including422; write5xx uncertain. Disposition preserves structured ok:false nonempty code even non2xx; write408/5xx or internal uncertainty becomes unknown. Plan is body-backed send but disposition_json maps send OutcomeUnknown to Transport because nonwrite. Corporate original special read parses JSON up to24MiB; generic read bounds MAX_RESPONSE and Value parser are permissive, not native schema validation.

sourceBounds.amount: JSON number, positive exact cents checked by decimal/exponent source spelling (not string/null), type7-family enum; currency uppercase3UTF16 units, companies distinct/complementary side. dispositionId trimmed NFC3..80UTF16; omitted/empty generates, explicit null rejected by native String. References1..64 unique after trimmed NFC UTF16 sorting; link journalEntryId native i64 then business1..safeMAX.
sourceBounds.heads: Optional ledgerHeadHash null/omitted allowed at parse; actual new link must equal current candidate head; no refresh, later changed head stale.
sourceBounds.state: Status asOf overdue only, balanced iff status posted and exceptions empty. No posting/payment by lifecycle.

retry.scope: Read/plan under current authority; no caller retry key. Exact normalized dispositionId/payloadHash, both endpoint companies, all retained party/corporate and settlement evidence, current stable principal, actual admitted ledger entries and heads. No idempotency-key (HTTP explicitly rejects header).
retry.ttl: No key TTL. Retained append-only disposition/history and immutable journal links.
retry.tombstone: No caller-key tombstone. Terminal settled/superseded state is retained; explicit authorized reopen appends lifecycle evidence only.
retry.naturalDedup: Plan can generate ID but does not persist business disposition; explicitly propose the returned normalized ID/body. Propose same payload only replays in proposed state. Approve returns existing approved/partly_posted/posted before distinct-principal check, otherwise only proposed with distinct author. Link permits approved/partly_posted only: same-side same-ID can return existing after current link validation; posted replay refuses. Settle already-settled returns existing before new settlement refs validation. Supersede terminal replay refuses; reopen only terminal, so repeated reopen refuses. Current authority/source/backup checks still precede storage replay.
retry.readBack: Global exact-ID status (optional asOf only overdue) returns retained heads/events/links, actual candidates/exceptions. Preserve original normalized body, ID, payload hash and returned heads; reconcile before another explicit action, never refresh heads or manufacture lost server IDs. Missing result or changed authority is not rollback.
retry.unresolvedProvider: No live provider approval, provider delivery, legal compliance, money transfer, journal posting or automatic external reconciliation is claimed.

input.originRequirement: Exactly explicit --server OR global --local-profile; server HTTPS unless literal loopback with explicit --allow-loopback-http; local Unix binding no TCP fallback.
input.argv: remote leaf command, selected split value flags; allow/confirm bare booleans only. Global --local-profile attached/split special; explicit profile XOR --server, no ignored flags. Flags may precede leaf inside remote argv, but remote command word remains first at main. original_args leaves native remote dialect opaque.

sdkReaderScope.rationale: ApiClient parses successful upstream JSON Value without typed output validation; these schemas constrain current actual native producer output, not every malicious/alternative upstream JSON value. No generic data-object placeholder.

refusal.transport: Main emits compact JSON newline; exit1 for returned ok:false including nested business core, exit2 invalid usage/input, exit1 transport/protocol/server refusal/uncertainty. No invented standard SDK wrapper around native disposition unknown result.

revisionConfirmationCapabilities.authority: Current human cookie. Reads WorkspaceRead + both companies CompanyOwnershipRead; writes WorkspaceManage + both CompanyOwnershipManage. Anchor must be endpoint of primary disposition. Party visibility/full corporate detail source authority includes historical settlement refs and replacement disposition. Current backup governance, namespace/readiness/source proof and transfer fence retained.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.revision: Exact normalized ID and payloadHash; independent stable principal on initial approval. Immutable journal links require actual posted nonreversed entry/date/currency/exact side amount and retained current heads. Later ledger writes stale links; no refresh/waiver. Status balanced iff posted without exceptions, never settled. No period reopening, posting, payment or consolidation effects.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.confirmation: Plan no confirmation; all six lifecycle writes inner confirm:true and CLI/MCP outer true. HTTP32KiB unique-key JSON recursively rejects duplicates; plan positional outer tuple allowed, write outer tuple blocked by confirm lookup. No extra fresh-MFA requirement beyond Current session.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.atomicity: Held Owner/control IMMEDIATE writer plus protected admitted two-company observations. Source physical originals and canonical journal chains checked; company snapshot read transactions rolled back, only control lifecycle commits. Selection restoration occurs BEFORE commit; restore failure rolls back and retires if nonreusable, server503 internal. Commit failure OutcomeUnknown retires. Plan/status rollback business transaction; broader admission/metadata absence is not inferred noneffect.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.globalPreprocessing: HTTP protocol-major/wire-profile/manifest negotiation precedes leaf. revisionConfirmationCapabilities.sdkValidation: Native body preflight uses actual domain::validate, not a full JSON Schema evaluator: ignores oneOf, uniqueItems, pattern and min/maxLength on null. revisionConfirmationCapabilities.transportStages: Every send first fetches passive protocol manifest without credentials on same transport; no redirects/proxy inheritance/retry, connect10s/total30s. Plan is body-backed send but disposition_json maps send OutcomeUnknown to Transport because nonwrite. Corporate original special read parses JSON up to24MiB; generic read bounds MAX_RESPONSE and Value parser are permissive, not native schema validation.

sourceBounds.amount: JSON number, positive exact cents checked by decimal/exponent source spelling (not string/null), type7-family enum; currency uppercase3UTF16 units, companies distinct/complementary side. dispositionId trimmed NFC3..80UTF16; omitted/empty generates, explicit null rejected by native String. References1..64 unique after trimmed NFC UTF16 sorting; link journalEntryId native i64 then business1..safeMAX.
sourceBounds.heads: Optional ledgerHeadHash null/omitted allowed at parse; actual new link must equal current candidate head; no refresh, later changed head stale.
sourceBounds.state: Status asOf overdue only, balanced iff status posted and exceptions empty. No posting/payment by lifecycle.

retry.scope: Exact normalized dispositionId/payloadHash, both endpoint companies, all retained party/corporate and settlement evidence, current stable principal, actual admitted ledger entries and heads. No idempotency-key (HTTP explicitly rejects header).
retry.ttl: No key TTL. Retained append-only disposition/history and immutable journal links.
retry.tombstone: No caller-key tombstone. Terminal settled/superseded state is retained; explicit authorized reopen appends lifecycle evidence only.
retry.naturalDedup: Plan can generate ID but does not persist business disposition; explicitly propose the returned normalized ID/body. Propose same payload only replays in proposed state. Approve returns existing approved/partly_posted/posted before distinct-principal check, otherwise only proposed with distinct author. Link permits approved/partly_posted only: same-side same-ID can return existing after current link validation; posted replay refuses. Settle already-settled returns existing before new settlement refs validation. Supersede terminal replay refuses; reopen only terminal, so repeated reopen refuses. Current authority/source/backup checks still precede storage replay.
retry.readBack: Global exact-ID status (optional asOf only overdue) returns retained heads/events/links, actual candidates/exceptions. Preserve original normalized body, ID, payload hash and returned heads; reconcile before another explicit action, never refresh heads or manufacture lost server IDs. Missing result or changed authority is not rollback.
retry.unresolvedProvider: No live provider approval, provider delivery, legal compliance, money transfer, journal posting or automatic external reconciliation is claimed.
